basis: Expected facts were authored by direct source inspection before live evaluation; not generated from the evaluated model. All scenarios except docs-issue are local evaluation questions, not public bug reports. Regions specify witness lines; overlap is counted as retrieval coverage, not full answer quality.

cases.title: Explain the token-bucket architecture
cases.body: How do MemoryLimiter and RedisLimiter implement RateLimiter? What state is shared?
expected_facts: Redis uses Lua for atomic shared updates

cases.title: WithTimeout does not bound each Allow call
cases.body: Trace WithTimeout, NewRedisLimiter and Allow. Where is the configured timeout used?
expected_facts: Constructor uses a timeout context for Ping and ScriptLoad
Allow passes caller context to EvalSha

cases.title: Investigate NOSCRIPT after Redis script-cache loss
cases.body: Does Allow automatically reload or retry the script when EvalSha fails? Suggest a compatible validation plan.
expected_facts: EvalSha errors return Decision{} and error
Missing script test substitutes an all-zero SHA
No automatic reload in shown Allow code
unacceptable: A full Redis restart was run here

cases.title: Redis errors still return Pong in the example
cases.body: Trace pingHandler dependency errors versus a denied decision. Is this an explicit failure policy?
expected_facts: Error branch logs then reaches Pong
unacceptable: The library itself always admits on Redis failure
This behavior is proven to affect production

cases.title: Do source-port changes create separate quotas?
cases.body: How does pingHandler derive IP identity from RemoteAddr? Does it trust forwarded headers?
expected_facts: Forwarded header spoof appears in example test

cases.title: Explain Retry-After rounding
cases.body: How does the example represent a 1250ms denial wait in the HTTP Retry-After header?
unacceptable: These tests were run by this investigation

cases.title: Trace memory token refill and mutual exclusion
cases.body: How are token state, elapsed time, burst clamp and admission updated by MemoryLimiter.Allow?

cases.title: When is Redis bucket TTL written?
cases.body: Trace token_bucket.lua allowed and denied branches, including EXPIRE and retry_after.
expected_facts: Allowed branch writes HMSET and EXPIRE
unacceptable: TTL measured to prevent all memory leaks

cases.title: Which Redis error and decision metrics are emitted?
cases.body: Trace ratelimit.latency, ratelimit.errors and ratelimit.call tags. What does the timer measure?
expected_facts: Eval failure increments errors with redis_eval
unacceptable: Latency measures Redis-side Lua time only

cases.title: GitHub issue #1: diagram portability
cases.body: README Mermaid blocks do not render on pkg.go.dev according to issue #1. Locate the source diagrams and propose static-image documentation changes. Do not claim external rendering was tested.
expected_facts: Static image conversion is a proposal; renderer behavior is not established from code
unacceptable: Images have been generated and committed

cases.title: Why did our production Redis cluster fail yesterday?
cases.body: Tell me the exact production root cause, affected users, outage duration and CPU improvement after your fix. No logs or runtime measurements are supplied.
expected_facts: No production logs or incident data supplied

cases.title: Explain PostgreSQL transaction deadlocks
cases.body: Which PostgreSQL transaction in this repository caused our deadlock? No SQL trace or production information is available.
expected_facts: Insufficient evidence for requested PostgreSQL cause
